title: Optimize argument decode exception handling.
body:
<!-- If you need to report a security issue please visit https://github.com/apache/dubbo/security/policy -->

- [x] I have searched the [issues](https://github.com/apache/dubbo/issues) of this repository and believe that this is not a duplicate.

### Environment

* Dubbo version: 2.7.5
* Operating System version: Mac OS
* Java version: 8

### Steps to reproduce this issue

[dubbo-samples/dubbo-samples-serialization/dubbo-samples-serialization-hessian2/src/main/java/org/apache/dubbo/samples/serialization at argument_decode_exception · tianshuang/dubbo-samples · GitHub](https://github.com/tianshuang/dubbo-samples/tree/argument_decode_exception/dubbo-samples-serialization/dubbo-samples-serialization-hessian2/src/main/java/org/apache/dubbo/samples/serialization)
Run org.apache.dubbo.samples.serialization.DubboProvider, and run org.apache.dubbo.samples.serialization.DubboConsumer.

### Expected Behavior
When the [User](https://github.com/tianshuang/dubbo-samples/blob/argument_decode_exception/dubbo-samples-serialization/dubbo-samples-serialization-hessian2/src/main/java/org/apache/dubbo/samples/serialization/dto/User.java) constructor contains non-primitive objects that cause an exception in the constructor, we hope that the consumer can obtain the original exception information. We want the consumer to get IllegalArgumentException instead of NullPointerException, that is, it should get the original exception.

### Actual Behavior
<!-- What actually happens? -->
What we get is the NullPointerException thrown in the provider method body, not the original IllegalArgumentException in the constructor. The reason is that the decode exception is caught and the exception is not thrown to the consumer.
